subject.title: Models: fully dynamic model discovery (OpenRouter + beyond)

question: Should OpenClaw support a maintained dynamic provider-catalog contract for configured providers such as OpenRouter, and if so which owner boundary controls cache, credentials, picker visibility, and configured-model policy?
rationale: This is a new provider/model-selection capability with compatibility and cost-control implications; the architecture cannot be selected safely from historical workarounds alone.

options.title: Approve a provider-owned dynamic catalog seam
options.body: Specify provider-owned discovery with explicit refresh, visibility, credential, and configured-model policy before accepting implementation work.

options.title: Retain static catalogs and document supported configuration
options.body: Keep catalog discovery out of the product contract and improve guidance for supported custom-provider model configuration instead.

recommendation.title: Approve a provider-owned dynamic catalog seam
recommendation.body: Specify provider-owned discovery with explicit refresh, visibility, credential, and configured-model policy before accepting implementation work.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned proposer in the supplied context; repository ownership history was unavailable for stronger routing.
